definition: Every completed 2026 REG game with its result and market number, plus the pre-kickoff availability captures that existed for it.

meta.captured_utc_basis: the retrieval date recorded by the session that made the capture (data/injuries.json meta.retrieved_utc = 2026-11-14). The exact clock time was not recorded by that session, so midnight UTC is used as a conservative floor and is labelled as such. It is EARLIER than any 2026 Week 10 kickoff, so treating it as pre-kickoff is safe; it is also EARLIER than the true read time, so it is conservative for the purpose of deciding which games it could have informed.
meta.derivation: engine/linelab/availability.py reads the CSV form; this file is a lossless reshape of the committed JSON to that form, not a re-fetch
meta.source_title: NFL.com Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season
meta.note: This capture was NOT re-fetched by the session that published the 2026-11-16 capture. It is the previously committed transcription, reshaped so that a mechanical delta between two official reads can be computed instead of an eyeball comparison.
meta.discrepancy_flag: Data/injuries.json records 345 player rows; this reshape yields 345. Any difference is a reshaping error and must be fixed, not explained.

meta.captured_utc_basis: clock time of the fetch, recorded by the session that made it
meta.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
meta.fetched_with: the page-fetch tool (the sandbox bash network cannot reach nfl.com)
meta.completeness: full page: all 8 chunks of 8 were read, so every team block on the Week 10 page is present
meta.note_on_counts: row_counts_by_team counts the player rows visible in the fetched page text. It is a completeness check on the fetch, not an official count; the official count is whatever nfl.com renders, and no count is asserted beyond what was read.

what_changed_vs_the_committed_2026-11-14.comparison_to: data/injuries.json (retrieved_utc 2026-11-14, 345 player rows, 28 team blocks, 14 games)
known_differences: DET: Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed now carry a game designation of Out. The committed capture already recorded Out for these three, so this specific defect is CLOSED, not open.
LAC team block now lists 21 rows; the committed capture's LAC count must be compared row by row before any claim is made about it.
GB Josh Jacobs now reads Did Not Participate In Practice with game status Out.
SEA Sam Darnold now reads Out; Drew Lock carries no game designation.
what_changed_vs_the_committed_2026-11-14.method: This capture is published for the delta to be computed mechanically by engine/linelab/availability.py against data/injuries.json, rather than by eye. Any difference the mechanical diff does not find must not be claimed.

independent_cross_checks: Lions out-list (Joseph, Mays, Reed) is independently confirmed by the club's own Week 10 status and by the official news article 'Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 10 games' linked from the same page.
Seahawks QB change (Darnold out, Lock starting) is confirmed by an official nfl.com news item linked on the same page.

known_gap: Captures held by this repository are dated after most 2026 games kicked off, so the forward corpus has fewer usable pre-kickoff availability vintages than games. That is reported, not papered over.
